autoIdentifyRules.SINGLE_ONE_HOT: Single-item single-qty orders are classified as hot when the number of same-SKU orders reaches the configured minimum orders-per-wave; after splitting by the max value, any remainder below the minimum falls back to single-item single-qty normal.
autoIdentifyRules.SINGLE_ONE_NORMAL: Single-item single-qty orders that do not reach the hot threshold, or are released from hot remainders, are classified as non-hot and may mix different SKUs.
autoIdentifyRules.SINGLE_MULTI_HOT: Single-item multi-qty orders are classified as hot when the number of same-SKU orders reaches the configured minimum orders-per-wave.
autoIdentifyRules.SINGLE_MULTI_NORMAL: Single-item multi-qty orders that do not reach the hot threshold are classified as non-hot and may mix different SKUs.
autoIdentifyRules.MULTI_FIXED_COMBO: Multi-item multi-qty orders are classified as fixed combo only when every order has the same SKU and quantity combination and the order count reaches the configured minimum orders-per-wave; any remainder after splitting by the max value is merged into multi-item non-fixed combo for wave planning.
autoIdentifyRules.MULTI_NON_FIXED: Multi-item multi-qty orders are merged into multi-item non-fixed combo for wave planning when SKU and quantity combinations differ, the fixed-combo threshold is not reached, or the order comes from a fixed-combo remainder.
